facts.text: Lunch is on me, mate, but I'm washing my hands first. Twice. Then I'll see to the loo.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Kenny's words. Wikiquote has no page for this film and the plot page has no matching line, so I could not confirm it and it reads as invented. Safer as an unquoted note.
facts.fix: Lunch is on me. Hands washed twice first, then I'll check the loos.
